objective: Qualify an external published individual-banding-derived source→destination colony movement event dataset for future source-specific geographic MRR, WITHOUT reading any 200/890 event rows or optimizing a biological prediction after exposure

declared_source.dataset_title_must_contain: natal versus breeding dispersal in arctic terns

declared_official_data_grain.Ad_DaD.csv: 200 breeding dispersal events (adults ringed as breeders)
declared_official_data_grain.missing_stayers: all sites with zero relocation not in the published 2 CSV tables
declared_official_data_grain.individual_ids: UID is a sequential event ID; original ring IDs missing, some adult re-dispersal events may not be independent

declared_source.declared_coordinate_rounding: WGS84 coordinates rounded to 0.01 degree in published event tables; displacement near small km scales uncertain
declared_source.source_status: published event-derived departure colony, not guaranteed primary original raw banding source identity

output: dataset DOI/version/title, publication date, file manifest names/sizes/official digests, metadata SHA256 only

stage1_future_gate_requirements: Freeze exact publisher version ID, published individual file size and digest from this source-only metadata receipt BEFORE opening event rows.
Verify original CSV SHA/row/header identities; separate true paired endpoints from published derived distances and rounded 0.01 degree coordinates.
Predeclare geographic feasibility radii, source roster that uses only earlier information, temporal cutoff and nonindependent unit before first outcome row.
Do not infer true natal origin through unobserved intermediate migration: ringed natal colony and first recorded breeding colony only, not complete trajectory.
Cannot use this dataset to infer movements that stayed at source, dispersal incidence, survival, detection probability or EOG's environmental/barrier axes.
Do not count adult repeat events as independent individuals without original ring IDs; event-level descriptive unit only.
Never score this as EOG-WF a fourth endpoint or claim independent prospective novel ecological discovery from already published data.
stop: Version/file identity, metadata byte caps or official producer provenance mismatch mean source STOP; do not select alternative versions after looking at content.
